title: 3dpc.a: C key-store lookup by origin AddrForKey address (lichen_key_store_get_by_addr)
description: Child of 3dpc, prerequisite of the sos_post re-key. Under the AddrForKey profile a routable 0200::/128 embeds no IID, so the store's IID-keyed lookup cannot be reached from a wire node address. Add to coap_keys_store.c + coap_keys.h: int lichen_key_store_get_by_addr(const uint8_t addr[16], struct lichen_key_entry *entry) - iterate valid entries, derive AddrForKey(pubkey) via lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 (link module, always built; verified 12/12 vs yggdrasil_address.json), memcmp the 16 bytes; -ENOENT when absent. Bounded store (CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES), no dynamic allocation. Host test alongside (or extend an existing coap_keys host test) pinning: known pubkey -> its AddrForKey vector from test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json; unknown address -> -ENOENT; NULL -> -EINVAL. Must land before 3dpc.b.
